title: The School Report (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy absurdist family Perth children
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The school report arrives in an envelope in December
With the assessment of the year and the things to remember
For improvement — and the teacher's handwriting is unchanged
From every teacher's handwriting since the era was arranged

[Pre-Chorus]
I have kept every school report from every child I've raised
And the things they were improving are the things they always praised

[Chorus]
The school report knows something I don't know
It knows the official version of the year's particular flow
The school report identifies the strengths and where they're going
And gets the direction approximately right but not the growing
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
Pete's reports said energetic and enthusiastic always
Joel's said thoughtful and methodical throughout all the hallways
Corey's said reliable and effective — every single time
And I read them now and see how precisely they were mine

[Bridge]
My own school report said shows potential — which is the way
That teachers communicate a specific kind of may
Never quite arrive — and it arrived — different than expected
But arrived — and the potential and the person intersected

[Outro]
School report knows… the potential is always right… school report knows
That's my boy
